key_idea: Travel time on every edge l/(v+x) is decreasing in x, so the shortest travel time is monotone in x: binary search x with Dijkstra on real weights.
sketch: First run Dijkstra with x=0 and print 0 if the destination is reachable within t. Otherwise binary search x in [0, 2e9] (x=1e9 always suffices since a simple path is at most 1e9 km and t>=1) for ~70 iterations, each a Dijkstra with weights l/(v+x) and early exit once the popped distance exceeds t. O(70 * m log n). Pitfalls: output exactly 0 when no speeding is needed, upper bound of the search, multi-edges, double precision.
